page.title: Privacy Policy
page.heading: How we collect, use and protect your information
page.intro: This Privacy Policy describes the information Divaine Tech collects, why we collect it and the choices you have. We keep it simple and transparent.
page.contact_text: Contact us to access, correct or delete your information.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Divaine Tech ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect when you visit our website or use our IT services, how we use it, and the choices you have.
By using our website or contacting us, you acknowledge the practices described in this policy.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect only what we need to respond to you and deliver our services.
items: Contact details you provide, such as your name, email address, phone number and company name.
Project information you share in enquiries, forms, emails and briefs.
Billing details needed to issue invoices and process payments (card numbers are handled by our payment providers, not stored by us).
Technical data collected automatically, such as IP address, browser type, device, pages visited and referring website.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use personal information for legitimate business purposes, including:
items: Responding to enquiries and providing quotes and support.
Delivering, maintaining and improving our services and website.
Sending project updates, invoices and important notices.
Sending news or offers where you have agreed to receive them; you can opt out at any time.
Protecting our website and users against fraud, abuse and security incidents.

sections.title: Cookies & Tracking
paragraphs: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to keep the site working, remember preferences and understand how visitors use it through analytics.
You can control or delete cookies in your browser settings. Disabling some cookies may affect how parts of the website work.

sections.title: How We Share Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only when necessary and with appropriate safeguards:
items: With service providers who help us operate, such as hosting, email, analytics and payment partners.
With professional advisers, such as accountants and legal counsel, under confidentiality duties.
When required by law, regulation or a valid legal request.
In connection with a business transfer such as a merger or acquisition, with notice to you where required.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described in this policy, to meet legal, tax or accounting requirements, or to resolve disputes. When it is no longer needed, we delete or anonymise it.

sections.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information, including access controls, encryption in transit and regular reviews of our systems.
No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. Please contact us immediately if you suspect any misuse of your information.

sections.title: Your Rights & Choices
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have rights over your personal information. You can contact us at any time to:
items: Request access to the information we hold about you.
Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete information.
Ask us to delete your information, where we are not required to keep it.
Object to or restrict certain processing, including marketing messages.
Withdraw consent you previously gave, without affecting earlier processing.

sections.title: Third-Party Links
paragraphs: Our website may link to external sites or embed third-party content. We are not responsible for their privacy practices, and we encourage you to read their policies before sharing any information.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our website and services are intended for businesses and adults. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If you believe a child has provided us with information, please contact us and we will remove it.

sections.title: International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Because we use service providers in different countries, your information may be processed outside your own country. Where this happens, we take steps to ensure it remains protected in line with this policy and applicable law.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page with a new "last updated" date. Significant changes may also be communicated by email or a notice on our website.
